claims.statement: KNTT Bài 22 includes basic properties, reduction and common-denominator work; common-denominator work is framed for favorable cases.
KNTT Bài 23 includes addition/subtraction of multiple rational expressions and bracket-rule use.
KNTT Bài 24 includes multiplication/division and use of multiplication properties.
Use exactly three diagnostic micro-practice items per Core card: base knowledge, misconception trap, Core application.
Distractor-level misconception triggers are evidence signals, not causal diagnoses.

proposed_changes.change: Return all 15 authored MCQ items as one batch, each with skill_id, layer, options, answer, hint ladder, explanation and option-level misconception_signal where justified.
proposed_changes.rationale: Pilot the complete closed loop before rollout.

proposed_changes.change: Use stable codes. Do not assign a causal remediation target unless supported by reviewed Knowledge Graph/rule.
proposed_changes.rationale: Avoid diagnosis from a single distractor.

tests.expected: Every distractor is mathematically plausible and maps to at most one primary misconception signal.
No Extension/Entrance10 item gates or contaminates Core.
MTC wording uses largest required exponent/power, never smallest.
All canonical answers independently recomputed before PASS.

uncertainties: Whether MTC_NOT_OPTIMAL should ever remediate to UCLN/BCNN is unresolved; treat it as a signal until graph evidence supports a target.

acceptance.notes: Gemini should return one packet covering the full 15-item batch, not incremental prose feedback.
